findings.desc: Required inventory lane passes without mechanical readLog are admitted as complete. WHY: the retained implemented saturation contract at docs/requirements/decisions/review-inventory-epoch-and-saturation-gate.md:129-140 requires both signed readManifest AND readLog for every pass/finding terminal; CHK-001 promises preservation of signed terminal read evidence. Actual current B-29bc:RP-001 (test-coverage/RR-004), RP-002 (concept/RR-003), and RP-004 (docs/RR-001) have readManifest but no readLog in .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-29bc/review-passes.json:3-29,30-71,133-163. RP-003 is a positive control with a persisted mechanical log. core/review-inventory-epoch.ts:309 accepts passes based solely on verifyReviewPass while the adjacent finding path requires both read fields; lines317-318 hash missing logs as null. handlers/finding.ts:554-557 accepts absent mechanical input for passes. Official purpose-bound review_run_start admitted RR-005 after those terminals, and fresh owner review_inventory_status reports all four lanes pass with only critic incomplete. This is not evidence that any reviewer failed to read; it is verified missing signed mechanical evidence and false complete-lane admission. Applicability candidate: directly blocks truthful current inventory completeness and the retained CHK-001 read-evidence promise, irrespective of whether the omitted guard predates this Story. Restore legitimate reviewer terminal read evidence without rewriting old records; preserve a failing missing-readLog admission control and repair the applicable producer/consumer path through authorized DEV scope. No topology or quorum claim is made.

Current verified inventory-critic Findings are omitted from the aggregate and cannot receive a completeness disposition. WHY: packages/main/src/core/review-inventory-epoch.ts:397-406 collects current-wave rawFindings only while iterating epoch.requiredLanes. The independent critic is deliberately not one of those four lanes, so its new signature-valid Finding is excluded. Concrete production witness: finding_add persisted B-29bc:F-001 on current purpose-bound RR-005 with signed manifest and mechanical readLog; finding_list returns it open/verified. The immediately following review_inventory_critic_set for RI-001/RR-005 with exactly one verified_family disposition for F-001 exited 1 with REVIEW_INVENTORY_FINDING_DISPOSITION_INVALID: B-29bc:F-001. The rejecting predicate is core/review-inventory-epoch.ts:435 and handler/review-inventory.ts:521. Thus a critic following the canonical duty to find missed issues cannot include its own discovery in the exact-set receipt; submitting an empty set would erase it from inventory accounting. This is a distinct aggregate completeness defect, not a second copy of the missing-readLog issue. Applicability candidate: directly blocks the explicitly promised independent critic workflow and per-Finding completeness in CHK-001/002. The required-lane aggregation predicate may predate B-29bc; do not label it an introduced regression without base proof. Preserve the real recorded Finding, include eligible critic discoveries in the immutable current aggregate through authorized scoped remediation, and retain a production negative/positive regression. No receipt was issued, no empty-disposition fallback was attempted, and no topology or quorum claim is made.
